How figures are calculated
How school-wise figures are calculated: for each competency, every assessed child's result is classified into Phala / Phula / Kadha. The school-wise bar shows what share (%) and count of children in that school fall into each band for that competency.

How student-wise figures are calculated: each child's own result is classified into a single band (Phala / Phula / Kadha) per competency. Click a roll number in the Student-wise tab to see the actual questions asked and exactly which ones that child got right (✓) or wrong (✗).

Source data: PARAKH 2027 Baseline Tools: Grade 2 – Koraput (assessment sheet, 2,939 children). In the sheet, a 1 against a question means the child answered it incorrectly and 0 means correctly. Where a competency is flagged All correct or All incorrect, that flag is applied to every question and shown as a tag next to the result. A child scoring 80% or more on a competency is Phala, 60–79% Phula, and below 60% Kadha.

Browse by block

Tap a marked block on the map to see the schools assessed there. Gold markers show how many schools in each block have baseline results.
